choice.basis: The independent_visual_notes explicitly state that in 2010, Hydroelectricity was 35% and Nuclear energy was 23%. Since 35% > 23%, Hydroelectricity had the higher generation share in 2010. The public task requires routing the source with the higher generation share to the higher-share follow-up workflow. The option 'Route 2010 Hydroelectricity to higher-share follow-up' directly matches this requirement.
